subject: Request: phased invoicing + partial prepay for Synergos pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Synergos pilot — ask for phased invoicing + partial prepay

Hi Grace,

Quick one — Synergos (pilot customer) signed MSA and wants to start a 6-month pilot next month. They are requesting a non-standard billing cadence:
- 50% upfront (to cover GPU reservations)
- Remaining 50% split into two quarterly invoices (month 3 and month 6)

They've also asked if we can offer a 10% pilot discount if they prepay 50% now. From sales perspective this seems reasonable to secure the pilot, but this is outside standard net30 terms.

Attached: SOW_Synergos_v1.pdf and payment_plan_proposal.xlsx with proposed dates (I linked the DocuSign form in the sheet).

Can you advise if we can approve (conditional) or if this needs exec sign-off?

Thanks —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0148
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synergos pilot — ask for phased invoicing + partial prepay

Marissa —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. A few notes:
- Our standard is net30; shifting to split/quarterly is atypical but less risky if we get 50% upfront.
- Discounting the pilot reduces our margin; need to confirm this is acceptable for a 6‑month pilot.
- Need clarity on termination and usage caps (so we can invoice the correct amounts if they stop early).

Karthik — can you run a quick risk/revenue calc (ARR run-rate impact, cashflow) and confirm whether Revenue Ops can provisionally approve the split schedule if we require the 50% upfront and a signed SOW with milestone acceptance? If yes, we'll request a one-time exception and document it in the deal.

If there's any additional mitigation (e.g., escrow for the prepay or a capped refund %), include that suggestion.

Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-20T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synergos pilot — ask for phased invoicing + partial prepay

Thanks — I reviewed the numbers. Summary:
- Pilot value (TCV) = $120,000 over 6 months.
- 50% upfront gives us $60k immediate cash; remaining $60k split into two $30k invoices in month 3 and month 6.
- Offering a 10% pilot discount reduces TCV to $108k; still acceptable for pilot given strategic value.

Conditions for Revenue Ops provisional approval:
1) 50% lump-sum payment due immediately on countersigned SOW.
2) SOW must include explicit milestone acceptance at month 3 and month 6 tied to invoice triggers.
3) Refund policy: prorated refund only for unused prepaid days >30 days after cancellation, capped at 25% of prepaid amount.
4) Payment method: ACH only (no credit cards) and finance contact on file (ap@synergoshealth.com).

If Grace is comfortable with the refund cap and ACH requirement, I can mark as approved in HubSpot as a one-time billing cadence exception.

Karthik
Revenue Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex D'Souza <alex@syndicateai.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synergos pilot — ask for phased invoicing + partial prepay

Alex —

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the SOW. Per internal review, we can proceed on the following conditional terms (please confirm):
- 50% upfront due on countersign (via ACH to Synergos payee details).
- Remaining 50% split into two invoices at month 3 and month 6.
- Pilot discount: 10% applied to total if 50% prepay is received.
- Refunds: prorated refund only for unused prepaid days beyond 30 days of cancellation, capped at 25% of prepaid amount.

I've included the DocuSign link for countersign and the SOW (see attached docusign_agreement_link.txt). Please confirm payment method (ACH contact) so we can generate the invoice schedule.

If you're good, we'll create a HubSpot milestone and mark deal DEAL-4583-SYNR as billing-exception:phased-invoice.

Best,
Marissa
From: Alex D'Souza <alex@syndicateai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Synergos Finance <ap@synergoshealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synergos pilot — ask for phased invoicing + partial prepay

Marissa / Grace / Karthik —

Thanks — that all looks acceptable from Synergos' side. We will:
- Countersign the SOW via the DocuSign link today.
- Submit 50% prepay via ACH within 5 business days to the account details provided in the SOW.
- Expect the two milestone invoices at month 3 and month 6.

One request: can Redwood provide a single consolidated invoice for the remaining two payments (split across month 3 and month 6) with a reference to the milestone acceptance? Synergos' AP prefers consolidated references for ERP mapping.

If that's doable, confirm and we'll proceed with countersign + ACH.

—Alex
VP Product, Syndicate AI (procurement on behalf of Synergos Health)
